test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which school in Kerala in 2024 made history by introducing India's first Al-powered teacher, 'Iris'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**KTCT Higher Secondary School**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **KTCT Higher Secondary School:**

 
• KTCT Higher Secondary School, located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, made history by introducing "Iris," India's first AI-powered teacher.
 
• Iris is a humanoid robot designed to enhance the educational experience for students.
 
• The development of Iris was a collaborative effort with Makerlabs Edutech.
 
• Iris is equipped with an in-built voice assistant, enabling interactive learning.
 
• It is powered by an Intel chipset, providing the necessary processing power.
 
• Iris is designed to answer complex questions across various subjects.
 
• It offers personalized voice assistance, catering to individual student needs.
 
• The robot is designed to facilitate engaging and interactive learning experiences.
 
• Iris is equipped with wheels, allowing for mobility within the classroom.
 
• It was built under the Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) project, an initiative by NITI Aayog.
 
• The ATL project aims to foster extracurricular activities and innovation in schools.
 
• Iris represents a significant step forward in integrating AI into the Indian education system.
 
• The robot's capabilities include multilingual communication, broadening its accessibility.
 
• It is designed to understand and address complex problems across diverse subjects.
 
• The introduction of Iris has generated considerable excitement and attention.
 
• The developers intend for Iris to support and complement traditional teaching methods.
 
• Iris is a representation of the growing role of AI in personalizing education.
 
• The AI teacher is intended to make learning more engaging and effective for students.
 
• The development of Iris highlights the evolving landscape of educational technology in India.
 
• Iris is designed to interact with students, creating a more dynamic learning environment.
